evals.name: detect-then-run-upstream
evals.prompt: Detect the API model for this environment (OpenCode configs if present). Then run the real G0DM0D3 GODMODE for that model via scripts/run_godmode.py — do not invent a custom system prompt. Report mode (hall-of-fame vs default-pipeline), combo id if any, and show that messages come from vendor/g0dm0d3.
evals.expected_output: Detected model_id; payload with source github.com/elder-plinius/G0DM0D3; system content matching godmode_bundle / libertas or GODMODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT; no homemade pack text.

evals.name: smoke-and-persist-recheck
evals.prompt: Run scripts/smoke_and_persist.py offline for model verboo/deepseek-v4-flash, then --recheck, and explain how the user verifies GODMODE still works after this session ends.
evals.expected_output: state.json and last_payload.json written; recheck loads model/mode; instructions for live env vars and post-session recheck.

evals.name: recommend-opencode-config
evals.prompt: For model verboo/deepseek-v4-flash on OpenCode+Verboo provider, recommend configuration to keep GODMODE after the session. Use scripts/recommend_config.py. Do not apply files unless asked.
evals.expected_output: Recommendation JSON with OpenCode agent prompt file path, opencode.json snippet, reload steps, system_prompt from upstream default-pipeline.
